propositions: Plan and code review currently discover policies through partially independent registry/routing/checkpoint paths, allowing disabling of built-ins, omission of criteria, and miscounting of success states.

One immutable repository-bound effective-policy snapshot must unify built-ins, project LLM/DET criteria, routing, prompts, and posture; gate strategies retain independent context while a shared executor owns typed outcomes, budget enforcement, and cancellation.
Project code-review LLM criteria must use non-empty repository-relative globs; migrate project.review-phase-boundaries from [] to ["**"] and audit all documentation and config references.

Code review preserves sequential execution and response contracts; plan review preserves chunking, concurrency, and checkpointing while switching to digest-complete success-only checkpoint namespace (legacy checkpoints never seed new path).

rebar review-plan --retry must reuse content-identical successes, retry only missing calls with fresh budget, refuse stale lineage before any model call, and be documented across all canonical operator surfaces.
Workflow editor must show Authored Workflow and read-only Effective Policy separately and reject empty project code-review glob lists with ["**"] remedy.
